facts.quote: Alice is not entitled to a deduction for Bob under section 151.

In 2017, Alice was paid $33200. Alice and Bob have been married since Feb 3rd, 2017. Bob earned $10 in 2017. Alice and Bob file separate returns. Alice is not entitled to a deduction for Bob under section 151. Section 63(c)(5) applies to Bob's basic standard deduction in 2017.
